    "kv-ibdp-dev",

    "ls_keyvault"

# ==========================================================

database_name = "control-db"

jdbc_url = (
    f"jdbc:sqlserver://{sql_server}:1433;"
    f"database={database_name};"
    "encrypt=true;"
    "trustServerCertificate=false;"
    "hostNameInCertificate=*.database.windows.net;"
    "loginTimeout=30;"
)

bronze_df = spark.read.format("parquet").load(bronze_path)
bronze_record_count = bronze_df.count()
print(f"Records Read: {bronze_record_count}")
display(bronze_df)

# ==========================================================
# Read Watermark
# ==========================================================

watermark_df = spark.read.jdbc(
    url=jdbc_url,
    table="(SELECT * FROM dbo.watermark WHERE source_name='customer') wm",
    properties=jdbc_properties
)

display(watermark_df)
